column2: Historical block-movement classification evidence and the current catalog gate input.
Every block class that overrides a hook the movement path reaches
must appear here, or `:block-catalog:checkClassification` fails the build. That is
the guarantee: not that every block is implemented, but that no block is
unaccounted for. UNSUPPORTED is a complete and safe answer — touching such a
cell must stop the rollout with a diagnosable reason (constraint 4). A class
that is simply missing is the dangerous one, because it reads as stone.
Columns: class, movement classification, server contact, reason.
The third column answers one narrow question, different from the second:
what body does this block's entityInside or stepOn run for a player on the
server beyond the movement path — a hit, an effect, a teleport, a freeze.
The capture writes it into the block's contact fact and the simulator's
server tick runs a MODELED body or refuses an UNMODELED one, so the
column must mean this hook family and nothing wider. A fallOn body is the
landing fact's. A fluid's body (WaterFluid, LavaFluid) is the fluid entry's,
resolved beside the block; LiquidBlock itself runs nothing on a player. A
world change the hook schedules (a tilting leaf, a breaking egg, a lit ore)
is not a body on the player. Reading lava's danger into LiquidBlock's row
once made every captured water cell refuse as an unmodeled block contact
in the source project; that is the mistake this contract exists to prevent.
NONE no such body, or one that writes nothing on a player
MODELED the simulator's server tick runs it; WorldCapture.contactFor names the class
UNMODELED a body the slice does not model; a visit refuses
Committed, unlike the generated catalog: this is a list of Mojang symbol
names recorded as committed conformance evidence, not derived Mojang data.
Keyed by implementing class, because a hook inherited from an abstract
ancestor is that ancestor's to classify, not each subclass's.
MODELED the kernel implements it and executable evidence verifies it
GEOMETRY_ONLY the override only computes a shape; proved shape is a
pure function of the state id, so the shape palette already
carries it and no handler is needed
NO_MOVEMENT_EFFECT the hook runs and touches nothing the audited vector
carries. Needs the body read AND a capture containing the
block agreeing raw-bit across the live, headless, and pure
one class that can produce a silent wrong answer.
Upgrading an entry out of UNSUPPORTED needs its own differential evidence.
Downgrading one needs none because safety is free.
